summary: Energys Group Ltd, via its UK subsidiary, acquired Cube Lighting and Design Ltd and Cube Solar Installations Ltd, its key delivery and fulfillment partners, effective August 20, 2026. A press release dated August 24, 2026, filed on Form 6-K, announced the acquisitions. No financial terms, price per share, premium, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed. The acquisitions aim to vertically integrate energy-efficient lighting and solar services, improve margins, and strengthen UK market position. Watch for further disclosures regarding financial impact and integration details.
